title: Group by and aggregate
summary: Split-apply-combine: groupby with sum, size and named aggregation, the best row per group, transform, and filtering groups.
hints: `revenue_by_region`: `df.groupby("region")["revenue"].sum()` is a Series indexed by region (sorted). Named aggregation builds several columns at once: `df.groupby("region").agg(orders=("revenue", "size"), units=("units", "sum"), avg_revenue=("revenue", "mean"))`, then `.round({"avg_revenue": 2}).reset_index()` turns the region index back into a column.

`top_rep_by_region`: total per (region, rep) with `df.groupby(["region", "rep"])["revenue"].sum()`, then on that Series `groupby(level="region").idxmax()` returns `(region, rep)` pairs for the best rep of each region; build the dict from them.

`add_region_share`: `df.groupby("region")["revenue"].transform("sum")` is the region total repeated on every row, aligned with `df`, so `(df["revenue"] / totals).round(3)` works. `regions_with_at_least`: `sizes = df.groupby("region").size()`, then `sizes[sizes >= n].index.tolist()`.
